stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, David Hamilton - great to have Chatswood GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.detail: 3 3-pointers, 4 blanks - no interest in the middle ground

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 4 & 5 - the field is on notice

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 14 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: On the Charge
stories.detail: Back-to-back 3-pointers on holes 3 & 4

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 1-5 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 7 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 13 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 17 & 18 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: One-Trick Pony (Technically Solid)
stories.detail: 6 1-pointers - found a formula and sticking to it

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: The Hunt Continues
stories.detail: 3 wipes and still no 3-pointers from 11 holes - they will come eventually

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 15 & 16 - the course always takes its cut

stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 15 & 16 - feast then famine

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12 - starting to look comfortable
